notes: ACCESS: plain HTTP curl (no special headers needed) worked for every page - lakeland.co.uk is a Shopify store. robots.txt fetched first: single generic 'User-agent: *' group plus named bots (AhrefsBot, Nutch, AhrefsSiteAudit, adsbot-google) - no ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/anthropic-ai/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entry anywhere, so no Claude-specific disallow applies; /collections/ paths are allowed (robots only blocks /collections/sort_by and /collections/+*). TREE: the rendered homepage mega-menu (Cooking & Dining, Baking, Cleaning, Laundry, Storage & Home, Electricals) has NO dedicated Bathroom tab - Lakeland is confirmed primarily kitchenware/homeware. However sitemap_collections_1.xml lists several bathroom-relevant orphan collections not linked from the live nav (bathroom-storage, vanity-storage, shower-caddy, mirrors, shower-basket-shelves, toilet-roll-holders, sink-storage, soap-dispenser, soap-dish, storage-hooks, toilet-brushes, bathroom-cleaning-products). Each was fetched directly and its breadcrumb trail read to recover the site's real (but unlinked) collection hierarchy: Storage & Organisation > Bathroom Storage > {Shower Caddy, Toilet Roll Holders, Shower Basket & Shelves, Soap Dispenser, Soap Dish}; Storage & Organisation > Vanity Storage (sibling, not child of Bathroom Storage); Storage & Organisation > Sink Storage (separate, kitchen-sink hierarchy); Cleaning > Bathroom Cleaning > {Bathroom Cleaning Products, Toilet Brushes}; Homeware > Home Decor > Mirrors. QTY: rendered collection pages are Algolia/JS client-rendered (curl shows 0 product cards even for known-populated collections like /collections/knives), so exact counts were taken from Shopify's own /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 endpoint (native HTTP, no browser needed) and counted by unique product handle. Cross-check: Bathroom Storage parent = 47 products via products.json = exactly Shower Caddy(27) + Toilet Roll Holders(3) + Shower Basket & Shelves(0) + Soap Dispenser(8) + Soap Dish(9), confirming the recovered child set is complete and the parent is a pure umbrella (per rule 24, only the deepest child URLs are recorded, not the Bathroom Storage parent). EXCLUSIONS/ROUTING: cross_category_url_index.json hit on /collections/mirrors (Wall_Decor.xlsx) and /collections/shower-caddy + /collections/vanity-storage (both Storage.xlsx) - all three routed to review per the mandatory OPTION-1 dedup rule, never to rows. /collections/mirrors independently confirmed NOT bathroom-specific anyway (Home Decor hierarchy; mixed with face masks, SAD therapy lights, jewellery case - a general personal-care grab-bag, not a bathroom mirror category). /collections/vanity-storage independently confirmed not bathroom despite its name (2 products: handbag organiser + generic utility container - dressing-table/vanity-table sense, not bathroom vanity). /collections/sink-storage (79 products) excluded as kitchen-sink-hierarchy dominant (dish racks, washing-up bowls, sink tidies); it contains a handful of toothbrush-holder items that would individually qualify under rule 13, but no dedicated bathroom-hierarchy URL exists for them (no toothbrush-holder collection in the sitemap) so per rule 27 (no invented URLs) and rule 12 (hierarchy decides) the whole collection is excluded, logged to review. /collections/bathroom-cleaning-products (37) excluded as cleaning chemicals/consumables (sprays, toilet-bowl tablets, hand sanitiser, limescale remover), not accessories/hardware. /collections/shower-basket-shelves is a real Bathroom Storage child but currently lists 0 products (empty), logged to review, not recorded as a leaf. /collections/storage-hooks (3) excluded - it is a child of Multipurpose Storage, not Bathroom Storage, and its items are generic hooks. /collections/toilet-brushes (25, under Cleaning > Bathroom Cleaning hierarchy) is INCLUDED as a Bathroom leaf per rule 14 (Toilet Brushes explicitly named) since primary product type overrides the cleaning-hierarchy placement (classification priority rule 2). No other bathroom fixtures (toilets, basins, baths, showers, taps, bathroom furniture/vanity units, bathroom mirrors, bathroom-specific storage cabinets) exist anywhere on the site - confirmed via full sitemap keyword scan (bath/toilet/shower/basin/sink/vanity/mirror/tap/faucet/sanitary) with no further matches beyond what is covered above.
